messages:
maria: Hey folks — opening a docs PR for the 'GetUp' quickstart demo. Need someone to sanity-check auth flow and the first-deploy steps before I merge. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4821 @aj @sam
aj: on it. I'll check the auth snippet and run the demo locally.
sam: i can smoke test deploy step. which branch?
maria: branch: docs/getup-quickstart. main changes: swapped SDK snippets to SDKv5, updated env var names, added note about CORS in private deploy. also fixed link to console screenshot
aj: quick question: the code uses process.env.RW_API_KEY vs RW_KEY — which one do we standardize on?
li: we've been moving to REDWOOD_API_KEY in new examples (per style guide). need to update snippet and mention migration note
sam: running through deploy now — hitting a 403 on step 3 when using sample token
maria: can you paste the curl output? maybe the token needs scope 'inference:invoke'
sam: here's the error
```bash
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "missing_scope",
  "message": "token requires inference:invoke"
}
```
aj: ok that's expected — our quickstart should call out required scopes. propose adding small table in auth.md and adding a pre-deploy check script `scripts/verify_token.sh`
maria: good idea. I'll add the script and update PR. @docs-bot can you run the linkcheck once I push?
docs-bot: scheduled: link-check for PR 4821 — queued. I will post results in this thread when done.
li: also, please update the SDK snippet to use `const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` to match style guide
maria: will do. Also, small UX note: I moved the first deployment to be after auth to reduce confusion.
sam: linkcheck result: one broken link to old console screenshot — looks like maria already updated but didn't push image asset
maria: uploading image now... pushing commit
docs-bot: link-check completed: 1 warning (image missing) -> fixed in latest commit 5f2a8c. No broken links remain.
aj: LGTM from docs side. One nit: the snippet still uses `await response.json()` without error handling. can we add try/catch example?
maria: adding tiny error-handling example. then i'll merge after a final quick test. thanks all :tada:
sam: :thumbsup:
li: :shipit:
